description: Read a web page in a browser tab as an accessibility tree with ref ids. interactive (default true) lists what can be clicked, typed into, hovered or scrolled, headings and status messages; false gives the whole page's text structure. ref narrows it to one element's subtree. Other sites' frames (payment forms) are read in place, their refs like f1e3. A ref keeps naming its element while it is on the page.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. e12

tab.description: Tab id, as `open` or `tabs` gave it

name: snapshot
title: Read Page
